_about: Varys's scope plan: OpenBao KV v2 mount 'homelab', one secret per scope (homelab/<scope>). Key NAMES only, never values. An entry script gets a scope when its import closure references one of the scope's keys (keeper.py plan). rotate_days drives the rotation reminders. Extra owner-approved grants live in ~/.olympus/bao/grants.json.
